purpose: One CPU opportunity audit of an alternative hypothesis using already collected training-scene states; no fitting and no method promotion from this table alone.
sampling: All saved episodes and all decision states, including forced terminal states; no outcome-dependent filtering.
undefined_move_comparisons: For states with no valid movement alternative, report missing and exclude the whole episode only from that score-specific result; retain all episodes in main opportunity table.
path_cost: Preserve full executed prefix and append discovered-graph return distance from final decision point. Cross-check baseline length with official per-episode report. Never truncate prefix.
spl: Use official GT reference-path length only if available and verified; no substitution of start-goal shortest distance. Otherwise counterfactual SPL is missing.
oracle_scope: Actual recorded decision observations only; passed intermediate nodes are excluded from oracle candidates.

known_before_audit.caveat: D1 expected counts came from joining selection IDs to existing baseline and require episode trajectory/metric parity before reuse; OSR may include intermediate unobserved nodes.

stopping_rule: A descriptive opportunity table, with at most this one fixed D1 analysis. Sparse independent failures are insufficient evidence; do not train or claim new novelty merely because a zero-training score changes outcomes.
